correctness.rationale: Forest Gibbs law is independent bond percolation with p_e=lambda_e/(1+lambda_e), conditioned on no cyclic block all-open. In a cactus, cycles share no edges and the conditioning factors over independent bridge/cycle blocks; two connectivity indicators factor along unique block-tree route, so nonnegative local covariances multiply. On one cyclic block, group edges between 3 or 4 marks; each segment all-open indicator is independent Bernoulli before excluding all-open state. Three distinct marks and noncrossing four-mark pairings have explicit products of nonnegative terms. For crossing four-mark pairings, computed (1-abcd)N_AB-N_A N_B exactly as sum of 21 nonnegative degree-(2,2,2,2) Bernstein basis products with weights 1/8,1/4,1/2,1/4,1/8 on specified cyclic/dihedral orbits. Independent sympy polynomial expansion confirms all coefficients and exact identity; independent weighted enumeration of 8-vertex three-cycle cactus (10 edges, Z=447824916) confirmed all 28×28 pair inequalities. Exact polynomial verification plus block factorization proves general statement, finite graph test alone does not.
